title: The One Arrest That EVERY Cop Fears
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On July 16, 2022, dispatch received a report of reckless driving in Fond du Lac County, WI. Deputies quickly located the suspect vehicle and attempted a traffic stop, but the truck sped away. After a pursuit, deputies successfully disabled the vehicle. However, during the process of ordering the driver to exit, it was discovered he was missing his pants as a result of an urgent restroom requirement.

Our featured content aims to depict law enforcement interactions, emphasizing education over public shaming or ridicule. In a world filled with misleading conversations about law enforcement, it's crucial to present these interactions within their contexts to inform and educate the public.
